from pathlib import Path
wcs_path=Path("astropy/wcs/wcs.py")
src=wcs_path.read_text()
old="        return self._array_converter(self.sip.foc2pix, None, *args)\n"
if src.count(old)!=1:
    raise SystemExit(f"WCS_ANCHOR_COUNT={src.count(old)}")
lines=[
"        def _sip_foc2pix(foccrd, origin):",
"            # Preserve the direct inverse-polynomial path when SIP AP/BP",
"            # coefficients are available.",
"            if self.sip.ap is not None and self.sip.bp is not None:",
"                return self.sip.foc2pix(foccrd, origin)",
"",
"            # Without AP/BP, invert the forward SIP map pointwise by the same",
"            # method of consecutive approximations used by all_world2pix.",
"            # sip.pix2foc returns focal-plane coordinates relative to CRPIX,",
"            # so foccrd + CRPIX is the undistorted zero-order pixel estimate.",
"            focal = np.asarray(foccrd, dtype=float)",
"            pix = focal + self.sip.crpix",
"            tolerance = 1.0e-4",
"            maxiter = 20",
"            tol2 = tolerance**2",
"",
"            for k in range(1, maxiter + 1):",
"                dpix = self.sip.pix2foc(pix, origin) - focal",
"                pix -= dpix",
"                dn = np.sum(dpix * dpix, axis=1)",
"                if np.all(dn < tol2):",
"                    return pix",
"",
"            (slow_conv,) = np.where(dn >= tol2)",
"            raise NoConvergence(",
"                \"'WCS.sip_foc2pix' failed to converge to the requested \"",
"                f\"accuracy after {maxiter:d} iterations.\",",
"                best_solution=pix,",
"                accuracy=np.abs(dpix),",
"                niter=maxiter,",
"                slow_conv=slow_conv,",
"                divergent=None,",
"            )",
"",
"        return self._array_converter(_sip_foc2pix, None, *args)",
"",
]
wcs_path.write_text(src.replace(old,"\n".join(lines),1))

"",

"",
"    for origin in (0, 1):",
"        focal = w.sip_pix2foc(pixels, origin)",
"        recovered = w.sip_foc2pix(focal, origin)",
"        assert_allclose(recovered, pixels, rtol=0.0, atol=1.0e-4)",
"",
]
test_path.write_text(tests.replace(anchor,"\n".join(tlines)+"\ndef test_sub_3d_with_sip():\n",1))
